The '''Imperial Spec Ops Officer armor''',<ref name="GCWRaR" /> or '''Imperial Spec Ops armor''' for short,<ref name="SWG:C3" /> was a special type of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] introduced during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GCWRaR" />

The Imperial Spec Ops armor was a full-body armor similar in appearance than regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armors. However, it was far more resistant and existed in two different colors: full black or white with black markings. The armor was also equipped with a shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] which color was customizable by the owner. The armor offered protection against kinetic damage as well as from energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SWG:C3" />

This armor was originally developed for [[Imperial Special Operations|Special Operations]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]<ref name="GCWRaR" /> but it was eventually provided to any Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who had reached the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|lieutenant colonel]] by proving superior fighting skills on the battlefield.<ref name="SWG:C3" /> The trooper [[HX-138]] wore parts of this armor dyed black during the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:FtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Spec Ops armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:C3" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]," on [[September 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
